C-45.Name: Interface language "As in system" (default for new profiles)
C-45.Summary: The UI language is a fixed code (default 'en') with no system option. Since 2.3.0 fixed locale loading, a language stored long ago (e.g. 'ru') suddenly takes effect. Add a "System" choice that follows the macOS/Windows preferred languages and make it the default for new profiles.

Problem.Description: User 2026-10-15: after updating to 2.3.0 the UI turned Russian on an English system (stored language 'ru'); «как в системе да».

Goals.R-1: New preference value language = 'system' with a label "As in system" (localized) first in the language select; the effective locale is resolved from navigator.languages: first entry whose language matches a shipped locale (en, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh-CN, zh-TW); zh-Hans/zh-CN/zh-SG → zh-CN, zh-Hant/zh-TW/zh-HK/zh-MO → zh-TW, pt-* → pt; fallback en.
Goals.R-2: Default for new profiles is 'system'; existing stored values stay as they are (no migration).
Goals.R-3: Re-resolve when the window regains focus or on the languagechange event, so a system language change applies without a restart.

Constraints.Constraint: No change to stored user choices; the native menu labels are out of scope.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Fresh profile on an English system shows English; switching the system to Russian and focusing Mark shows Russian; a stored 'ru' stays Russian until the user picks "As in system".

C-45.VerificationIntent: Unit tests for resolution and the default; settings select shows the option.
